#56 - The Value Of The Marquisate

Chapter 56 The Value of the Marquis Family

Although the drunk nobleman was not very confident at this time, he became arrogant again when he thought of his cousin Cleos Frey.

Cleos Frey is the eldest son of Emmon Frey, and Emmon Frey is the second son of Walder Frey, the head of the Marquis of the Twins.

In other words, his cousin is the son of the second son of Marquis Frey. Originally, this relationship was not very reliable, but his cousin has a very unusual relationship.

Cleos is the cousin of Queen Cersei, Kingslayer Jaime of the Kingsguard, and Tyrion!

Because Cleos' mother is Genna Lannister, the sister of Duke Tywin.

Of course, she should be called Genna Frey now.

His cousin's cousin is the queen, and he is also the queen's cousin.

With this relationship, he feels that he should walk sideways in King's Landing.

Of course, it is a bit disadvantageous to show his title and identity at this time.

Because he was just the heir of a small viscount, he had no power in King's Landing.

At least he had to wait until his cousin came to support him, so that he could completely overwhelm this group of people.

So he pretended to be confused, suddenly covered his head, and groaned:

"Ouch, this dog hit my head, my noble head."

The captain saw this situation and knew how to deal with it.

The nobleman who was beaten was obviously a small nobleman. His status could not be compared with the first heir of Haijiang City, so he pretended to be crazy and stupid.

Both parties were nobles, and they could not hurt their face too much. If the Haijiang City party who beat people did not pursue it, the matter would be over.

"It seems that Lord Patrick is right. If you have no doubts, you can leave." The captain changed the object of flattery.

His idea was to let the people of Haijiang City go first, and then let the nobleman who was beaten go.

In this way, neither side would be offended.

But things did not go as planned.

Patrick nodded, and was about to turn around and tell Arthur to leave, but he saw his companion motioning him to sit down and watch the show.

The Lord of the Moulin Rouge looked at the captain of the gold robe, "Didn't you want to take us down as soon as you entered the door? Now we are in the right, I want to see if you can take down those who are not in the right."

Arthur made up his mind to watch the excitement.

See how this gold robe who judges the right and wrong with his title will deal with the drunk nobles.

Hearing this, Patrick also felt that he should vent his anger.

So he also followed Arthur, sitting on the bench leaning against the table, with his elbows on the table ready to watch the show.

Seeing that his side had the upper hand, Desmond did not leave and sat down.

The captain suddenly felt a headache. He had just judged that the people of Haijiang City were in the right, so he should arrest the party that was not in the right and making trouble.

But the problem was that the party he judged to be in the wrong was the one who was beaten.

And it was a nobleman he dared not offend.

He gritted his teeth, smiled, and walked up to Patrick and said:

"Sir, please spare these people, they were beaten up, and they are also pitiful people."

Arthur sneered: "Those who were beaten are pitiful people, so isn't the little girl who was harassed by him a pitiful person?"

Patrick thought of Arthur's righteous behavior and felt proud, so he said: "Yes, the little girl is also pitiful. We are right, you can't let him go."

"You are right, can't you go around?"

"No, why should we be merciful when we are right." Arthur refused flatly.

The captain felt that he was overwhelmed. The people over there didn't dare to arrest, and the people here were unforgiving.

He felt that the world was about to collapse.

Just then, a voice came.

"You are from Haijiang City, right? You are quite arrogant. You dare to bully my cousin!"

A group of people came in with a nobleman in his thirties with mediocre features.

The captain of the noble gold cloaks knew that it was Cleos Frey, the notorious cousin of Queen Cersei, who was infamous throughout King's Landing.

He immediately made a judgment and trotted to the queen's cousin.

"Lord Cleos, I was just about to stand up for your cousin, but these people were tough..."

"Okay, I get it." Cleos waved his hand in a pretentious manner and asked the captain of the gold cloaks to withdraw.

Then he looked at Arthur and his friends who were sitting carelessly at the table.

"Tell me, what do you mean by hitting my cousin?"

Arthur instantly had a clear understanding of this man's shamelessness.

This person who took the initiative to hit someone was not Arthur and his friends.

"Cousin, they..." The drunk nobleman saw that his backer had come, and his head was no longer a headache. He jumped up and slid to his cousin and started to complain.

Cleos pretended to listen to his cousin's words, but his eyes were wandering around Patrick, thinking that he could extort a large sum of money this time.

So he pretended to be righteous and said: "In the matter of my cousin, you not only took the initiative to beat him, but also bullied a drunk nobleman. How despicable! Tell me, how do you want to solve it."

"Let the gold cloaks catch him and it will be solved." This was Arthur's answer.

Patrick expressed his agreement with his companions with laughter.

"You are simply lawless. If you don't compensate me... and my cousin with a thousand gold royals, you can't leave."

Cleo wanted to ask them to compensate him with a thousand gold royals, but when the words came to his lips, he realized that his cousin was the victim, so he changed his words.

"Not only that, I want that woman too."

Cleo's cousin shouted at the right time.

"I don't have money, but I have fists. If you have the guts, come and get them."

"How dare you! Fight me." Cleo was furious when he saw that this group of people didn't care about his threats at all.

"I want to let you know the value of the Marquis' family."

He asked the twenty servants around him to rush up and teach this group of people a lesson, and at the same time instructed several gold robes to go up and fight.

The captain of the gold robes suddenly felt that he was unlucky to encounter such a scene today.

He should stop the fight now, but he didn't dare to offend the queen's cousin, so he walked forward slowly, praying that Cleo's men would hit the people of Haijiang City first.

In this way, they didn't have to fight and took a neutral attitude.

The few customers watching around saw this situation and also persuaded Arthur and his men to bow their heads.

"It's a small matter to pay a few gold dragons, but it's a big matter to offend the queen's cousin."

"Oh, don't be so arrogant. There are more than 20 of them, and you are only five or six. You can't beat them."

"Young people should not be too arrogant. You should bow your head when you should."

Arthur glanced at the people watching the fun and shook his head with a smile.

A frog in the well is not worth getting angry.

"I will let you know the value of the Marquis family now, and that is to be beaten by me."

He stood up first, raised his fist and hit the first person.

Patrick followed, and he now thought Arthur was unbelievably handsome.

Desmond was mature. He realized that Cleo wanted to extort money, so he didn't rush up at the first time, but repeatedly advised Arthur not to do it.

But the situation in front of him was beyond his expectations.
